rustBody: let mut source=fixture();if case["id"]=="metadataRetainingEmpty"{source.nodes.clear();source.edges.clear();}else if let Some(word)=case["word"].as_str(){let value=f64::from_bits(u64::from_str_radix(word,16).unwrap());source.nodes[0].position=SemioPoint2{x:value,y:value};if case["id"].as_str().unwrap().starts_with("singleNodeEmptyRelations-"){source.nodes.truncate(1);source.nodes[0].params.clear();source.edges.clear();}}source
hydrate: for(const node of source.nodes){node.position.x={bits:BigInt("0x"+(node.position.x as unknown as {bits:string}).bits)};node.position.y={bits:BigInt("0x"+(node.position.y as unknown as {bits:string}).bits)}
